name: app-black-closing-case-card-with-circular-text-seal
title: Black closing slide with a white circular text seal, CREATE and DOMINATE, and credits
whatItIs: A black slide with a white circle holding a black zigzag mark ringed with repeating 'CREATE.DOMINATE.' text, the words CREATE and DOMINATE on each side, a logo at the top left, studio name centred at the top, year at the right, a paragraph at the bottom and project and designer credits at the corners.
whatItMeans: Confident and final; a seal is a fitting sign-off.
techniques: Ring a symbol with circular monospace text.

vocabulary.definition: A circular badge with text set around a symbol.
Small text in the four corners.
A short call-to-action at the bottom.
